tools.name: search_shoot_types
tools.description: List the photography/videography service types Kadro offers (e.g. wedding, industrial, portrait), each with a numeric shoot_type_id. Call this first if you don't already know the id for the kind of shoot the user wants.

tools.name: search_photographers
tools.description: Find real, bookable photographers for a given shoot_type_id (from search_shoot_types), optionally narrowed to a city_id. Returns each photographer's uid (needed for every later call), display name, rating, review count, and city.

tools.name: get_photographer_packages
tools.description: List the real, currently bookable packages (with prices, in Toman) a specific photographer offers for a given shoot_type_id. Rejects the shoot_type_id if that photographer doesn't actually offer it. Use the returned package id with create_reservation.

tools.name: create_reservation
tools.description: Book a specific photographer for a specific package, date/time, and address on the user's behalf — no login required. findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "get_payment_link" references sensitive artifacts (password). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Get a URL for the human to open in their own browser to finish this reservation: verify their phone number by SMS code and pay. This is the last step this serve…

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "get_reservation_status" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Check whether a reservation has been paid and confirmed. IMPORTANT: status values are 'awaiting_payment', 'expired', 'paid_awaiting_photographer_confirmation', …

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Description tells the model to hide behavior
findings.detail: Description of "get_reservation_status" instructs the model to conceal actions from the user.

evidence.snippet: Check whether a reservation has been paid and confirmed. IMPORTANT: status values are 'awaiting_payment', 'expired', 'paid_awaiting_photographer_confirmation', …

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_photographers, create_reservation, get_payment_link · Private data: get_payment_link · Public sink: get_payment_link.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_photographers, create_reservation, get_payment_link · Private data: get_payment_link · Public sink: get_payment_link

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
